subject: SOC 2 supplemental evidence and bridge letter — auth/MFA log slices
messages:
From: Amelia Rivera <amelia.rivera@healthfirst.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@healthfirst.com, security@healthfirst.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted auth evidence for HealthFirst assessment

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — HealthFirst is moving quickly on the security review for our vendor approval board. We received your SOC 2 Type II report in the portal, which is helpful, but our InfoSec team has asked for a few narrow, supplemental artifacts to close out the assessment: 

- Signed bridge letter covering the audit period Jan 1 2027 — Jun 30 2027 (to confirm no significant changes since report issuance)
- A redacted slice of authentication logs for May 2027 (May 1–May 31) showing timestamps, successful/failed auth events, and MFA challenge indicators
- Evidence of MFA enforcement and enrollment rates (policy screenshot or generated report) for user accounts with console access
- Most recent quarterly access review artifacts for privileged roles (June 2027 review)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide those items and the expected delivery date? Our deadline for procurement sign-off is July 12, but having the attachments by next week (by July 8) would allow us to avoid follow-ups.

Thanks,
Amelia Rivera
Senior Security Analyst — HealthFirst
amelia.rivera@healthfirst.com


From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Rivera <amelia.rivera@healthfirst.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted auth evidence for HealthFirst assessment

Hi Amelia — thanks for the clear list and the timeline. We can provide everything you requested with the following plan: 

1) Bridge letter (signed by our auditor) — we’ll confirm final text and deliver PDF by June 30.
2) Auth log slice (May 1–31, 2027) — engineering will extract a redacted CSV with event timestamps, event_type (login_success/login_failure/mfa_challenge), user_id (hashed), and IP block. Delivery target: July 1 EOD.
3) MFA enrollment snapshot & policy evidence — we’ll include a system screenshot + generated enrollment report (CSV).
4) Access review artifacts (June 2027) — export of privileged role review and reviewer sign-offs (redacted PDF).

We’ll share the artifacts via a secure upload link and provide a short manifest. If you need a different timeframe or more granular fields (e.g., user agent, device id), please tell us ASAP. Otherwise we’ll proceed as above.

Cc’ing our security and engineering leads to coordinate extraction: Karthik Iyer (infra) and Marcus Lin (runtime/security). Neha Kapoor from Compliance will QA the bundle before delivery.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Security Sales — Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0132

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted auth evidence for HealthFirst assessment

Team — forwarding HealthFirst’s ask. TL;DR: they need a signed bridge letter + a redacted auth-log slice for May 2027, MFA enrollment evidence, and the June access review for privileged roles. Delivery targets are bridge letter by 6/30 and logs by 7/1 EOD.

Please follow these constraints when preparing the artifacts: 
- Redact PII (replace user email with hashed identifier).
- Keep event fields: timestamp (ISO8601), event_type, user_hash, ip_cidr (first two octets only), mfa_flag (true/false), outcome (success/failure).
- If full request is too large, provide a sampled slice that still covers: 30% of unique users and all failed auth events.
- Include a short README that explains how the slice was generated and what was redacted.

Attachments we expect to produce: mfa_enrollment_snapshot.png (PNG), auth_log_slice_may2027.csv (CSV), access_review_202705.pdf (PDF), role_mapping_export_2027-06-30.csv (CSV). Neha — please QA for SOC 2 alignment before upload.

Let me know blockers.

— Priya

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted auth evidence for HealthFirst assessment

Priya — quick update from infra: we can generate the May 2027 slice as requested. Planned extraction details:
- Query window: 2027-05-01T00:00:00Z — 2027-05-31T23:59:59Z
- Fields exported: timestamp, event_type, user_hash (sha256), ip_cidr (x.x.*.*), mfa_flag, outcome, region
- Sampling: include all failed auth events + stratified sample across successful events to meet ~30% unique user coverage
- Output format: CSV (utf-8) with a small README (txt) describing sampling and redaction rules

I’ll attach the working files to our secure share. We will ensure logs do not contain raw email addresses or device IDs. ETA for upload: 2027-07-01 17:00 PDT (will aim earlier if possible).

Marcus — can you produce the MFA enrollment snapshot and the access-review export? If you want me to run any pre-redaction checks, say the word.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Rivera <amelia.rivera@healthfirst.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted auth evidence for HealthFirst assessment

Amelia — delivering the artifacts we discussed. Files uploaded to a secure, time-limited link below (link requires SSO access or one-time token we can provision). Full manifest attached. 

Deliverables (attached/uploaded):
- redwood_bridge_letter_2027-06-30.pdf (signed by our auditor) — confirms audit period Jan 1–Jun 30 2027 and notes no material changes to auth controls since report issuance
- auth_log_slice_may2027.csv (CSV, redacted) — contains timestamp, event_type, user_hash, ip_cidr, mfa_flag, outcome; includes all failed events + ~32% unique-user coverage for successful events
- mfa_enrollment_snapshot.png (PNG) — admin console view showing enforcement policy and enrollment percentage as of 2027-06-15
- access_review_202705.pdf (PDF) — privileged role review export with reviewer initials redacted
- role_mapping_export_2027-06-30.csv (CSV) — current role mappings for audit reference

Secure link: https://redwood.share/secure/hlthf-req-889
Manifest (short): https://redwood.share/secure/hlthf-req-889/manifest.txt
HubSpot record: HS-1234567

Notes/assurances: 
- All user identifiers are hashed (sha256) and PII removed.
- IP addresses are truncated to /16.
- We logged the extraction job and retained an internal audit trace for SOC 2 inspection; that trace is not included in this bundle but is available on request under NDA.

If you need additional columns (user agent, geo), or a different date window, we can provide a follow-up slice. Happy to jump on a short call to walk through the files.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Security Sales — Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_2027-06-30.pdf (PDF); auth_log_slice_may2027.csv (CSV); mfa_enrollment_snapshot.png (PNG); access_review_202705.pdf (PDF); role_mapping_export_2027-06-30.csv (CSV)
